title: Private Tarot Card Reading & New Orleans Voodoo
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enter the mystical side of New Orleans! Receive a private Tarot reading from the creator of the Marie Laveau Tarot, enter a real Voodoo shop & uncover the Vieux Carré's darkest spiritual secrets. Look beyond the familiar sights of the French Quarter and make room for a more personal encounter with the city's mystical side. Your private Tarot reading offers a moment to pause, reflect, and explore the cards with the person who created this distinctive deck. Bring a question or simply your curiosity, and discover what the imagery brings to mind. Step inside a real Voodoo shop, where your curiosity about New Orleans' spiritual traditions takes on new setting. Along the way, let the atmosphere of the Vieux Carré draw you into a city where mystery is part of the allure. Whether Tarot is new to you or already part of your life, this experience invites you to see New Orleans from a different perspective. Come curious, embrace the unexpected, and leave with a story that feels uniquely your own.
